bills.title: Public Health (Tobacco and Other Products) Bill 2023

name: The majority voted against an [amendment](https://www.openaustralia.org.au/senate/?gid=2023-11-27.169.2) to the usual second reading motion, which is "*that the bill be read a second time*" (parliamentary jargon for agreeing with the main idea of the bill). This means that amendment failed. ### Amendment text > *At the end of the motion, add ", but the Senate:* > > *(a) notes that the bill fails to combat the trade of illicit tobacco; and* > > *(b) calls on the Government to commit to combating this trade as a priority".*
